A North American cable operator: a Telecom, Media & Entertainment program run on the outcome-linked model with a blended Dataq Software team. The name stays behind the NDA; the numbers are published with permission.
IVR containment metric masked unresolved contacts; repeat contact climbing.
Agents lacked account context at escalation; transfers stripped history. Compliance transcript duties handled manually.

We rebuilt conversational care: grounded voice/chat agents resolving top ten intents end-to-end, emotion-aware escalation with full context handoff, agent-assist summarization, and resolution analytics steering staffing. Compliance (consent, disclosure, retention) automated in the flow.
